Letter from each row's first <td>, spec from each tier-list-entry's FIRST img alt looked up WHOLE against the roster. Both registered pages fetched by direct browser-UA GET, HTTP 200: /guides/tier-list/raiding 160 KB and /guides/tier-list/mythic-plus 167 KB decompressed. Parsed from the tier__tier / tier__title / data-original-title markup and resolved by ROSTER MATCH rather than container position, which is again what rejects the M+ page's second tierlist: its eight entries are dungeon-difficulty blocks (Altar of Fangs, Den of Nalorakk, King's Rest, Murder Row, Ruby Life Pools, Temple of Sethraliss and two more) and none maps to a spec. Counts reconciled before merging: raid 40 unique of 40, M+ 40 unique of 40, 0 unmatched. ZERO letters moved in either bracket. The pages' own 'Last Updated' lines are unchanged at 10th August 2026 (raid) and 13th August 2026 (M+), which is the honest explanation for a static parse; the snapshot advances because we fetched today, the page dates do not. Era: both self-identify as Midnight Season 2, no Season 1 string anywhere, Devourer present in the raw markup. seasonVerified stays s2.

All 6 registered pages fetched with the full browser header set (a UA-only request is Cloudflare-403), HTTP 200, 74-339 KB decompressed; r.jina.ai deliberately NOT tried, it has been IP-403 on wowhead.com/guide/* since 2026-08-03. Parse per the recorded recipe: unescape \/ -> / across the whole document FIRST, then find the [tier-list=rows] ... [/tier-list] block (never anchor on WH.markup.printHtml - the raid-healer page carries a decoy call), segment on [tier-label ...]X[/tier-label] with tolerant whitespace, and resolve each [spec-badge=<spec>-<class>] kebab slug against the roster. Exactly one tier-list block per page. Counts reconciled before merge: raid 27/7/6 = 40, M+ 27/7/6 = 40, 80 rows, 0 unmatched slugs, 0 duplicate-tier conflicts, all letters inside the registered 7-band wowhead scale. 10 letters moved, and every one is on a page that was re-cut: raid DPS (dateModified 2026-08-31T15:47:46-05:00) Arms Warrior S -> A, Arcane Mage B -> A, Havoc Demon Hunter A -> B, Devourer Demon Hunter A -> B, Augmentation Evoker C -> B; raid TANK (2026-08-31T15:53:10-05:00) Protection Paladin B -> A, Guardian Druid B -> A, Vengeance Demon Hunter B -> A, Brewmaster Monk A -> B; M+ TANK (2026-09-01T09:55:11-05:00, the only page dated today) Protection Paladin A -> B. The three unchanged pages moved nothing. published re-read per page and written: raid 08-31 / 08-31 / 08-31, M+ 08-28 / 08-26 / 09-01. Era: all six self-identify as Midnight Season 2 and Devourer is present in both DPS lists. seasonVerified stays s2.

MERGED tonight, and the manifest date is exactly why the row is not 'success'. This is the 2026-08-04 pinned-manifest shape returning: data.wowmeta.com/manifest.json HTTP 200 with snapshotDate STILL 2026-08-11 (completedAt 2026-08-11T22:52:39Z, 21 days), while rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json came back HTTP 200 at 161,637 bytes with Last-Modified 'Tue, 01 Sep 2026 00:21:38 GMT' (161,191 bytes / 11 Aug last night). The two steps run independently, so a frozen snapshotDate is not evidence of frozen data - the payload was DIFFED rather than trusted. Selection as specified: 44 blocks, whitelist categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} + sortField lowerBound + keyRange undefined = 27+7+6 = 40 rows (melee/ranged excluded as dps subsets). ALL 40 lowerBound values moved and every numberOfCharacters grew, several severalfold (Arcane Mage 38,032 -> 228,312; Blood DK 61,738 -> 179,977), i.e. an accumulating population rather than a re-scale; largest value move Augmentation Evoker 415.6 -> 321.6 (-22.6%), family median about -3%, so well inside maxValueMovePct. Merged at 1 dp to match stored precision, n from numberOfCharacters, and asOf stays the SOURCE's manifest.snapshotDate 2026-08-11 rather than today - so the coverage date correctly does not advance and the staleness red remains the honest signal.

This is the OWNER-ACCEPTED standing red recorded in the contract label: no S2 fetch path exists while the HTML statistics transport is Cloudflare-blocked and the GraphQL rdps family errors. HELD WHOLESALE for a seventh night - a DELIBERATE HOLD, not a fetch failure, and the picture is unchanged from last night. All 27 DPS charts requested at talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk with 3 retries each: 22 return real payloads, every one carrying simc_settings.tier = MID2 (read off each chart, never hard-coded) at chart timestamp 2026-08-29; the same 5 return the 76-byte {"status": "error"} body on every retry - Balance Druid, Feral Druid, Augmentation Evoker, Devastation Evoker, Retribution Paladin. Against the 26 stored MID1 profiles (2026-07-08 / 07-15), wholesale adoption of the 22 would drop 26 -> 22 rows = 15.4%, inside maxRowDropPct 0.25; what still blocks it is the value move - 114 of the 132 overlapping target rows move more than 60% (MID2/MID1 ratio min 1.152, median 1.870, max 2.833), tripping maxValueMovePct 0.6, and that gate has no agent-writable proposal channel: only a human value_move_ack re-run or a reviewed local run can land it. The tier-uniformity invariant separately forbids a pool holding both MID1 and MID2, and 'adopt what exists, null the rest' is blocked by the row floor. Nothing merged; fightProfile.asOf stays each chart's OWN timestamp, so the coverage date does not move and the staleness red is the honest signal.

HELD for a seventh night; the blocker is still maxValueMovePct alone. MID2_Raid.txt is 1.29 MB, Last-Modified 2026-09-01T07:28:41Z, header '12.1.0.69497 Live (hotfix 2026-09-01/69497, git build HEAD adc39a57a2)' - a NEW build hash (3b891e639e last night), so upstream is re-simming daily rather than frozen. Its DPS Ranking: block maps by longest-prefix (hyphen allowed) to 22 of 27 DPS specs; absent are Balance, Feral, Augmentation, Devastation and Retribution, the same five Bloodmallet is missing. MID1_Raid.txt is again 272 BYTES (Last-Modified 2026-09-01T07:07:07Z), an in-progress run with no ranking block, and carries the SAME build header as MID2 - so MID1 is neither the 12.0.7 artefact the contract label describes nor usable as a fallback. Wholesale adoption would drop 26 -> 22 stored rows = 15.4%, inside maxRowDropPct 0.25, but all 22 overlap rows move more than 60% (MID2/MID1 ratio min 1.692, median 1.997, max 2.351), so the value gate fires and needs the human value_move_ack. Nothing merged; the stored 26 rows and their 2026-08-08 date are byte-identical.

MERGED 39 rows - the period id did NOT advance but the data did, which the period alone would have hidden. /period/latest HTTP 200, 196 KB, still 302-resolving to period 1078, but the subtitle is not identical to last night: 'Period 1078, week 2 of MID2 ... Top 2000 keys, 10000 characters (2671 unique), 17.3 average key level' against 2833 unique / 17.2 last night. Parse bounded to the 'Spec representation in top keys' section (scanning the whole page picks up the Classes-and-specs block and the per-dungeon sections and yields ~59 rows), labels normalised on [-\s]+ with whitespace-tolerant number matching: 39 rows, 0 unmatched. Sanity-checked BEFORE merging - series sum 99.9 with role subtotals DPS 60.0 / Tank 19.9 / Healer 20.0, i.e. the representation share and not the /meta per-key-presence column (that one measures 7-10x higher with many exact zeros). 25 of 39 values moved, largest Unholy DK 1.5 -> 0.9, Arms Warrior 11.5 -> 12.2, Demonology Warlock 3.5 -> 3.9; all values are under minValueMagnitude 100 so the value-move gate does not apply. Frost Mage is BACK upstream at an explicit 0.0 (it was the absent spec last night) and Fire Mage is now the absent one, keeping its stored 0 at 2026-08-30 - a legitimate upstream absence, not a parse failure. Merged at asOf 2026-09-01.

TWO real feed changes tonight, both read from the canonical Blizzard source rather than the Wowhead mirror. (1) NEW ENTRY 2026-08-31, kind 'hotfix': Kaivax's running hotfix post (us.forums topic 2336376, post 1 at version 23, updated 2026-09-01T01:10:18Z) read with its <ul> heading structure INTACT. Every class line sits under an explicit SPEC heading, so no class-wide or hero-tree guess was needed: Unholy DK, Restoration Druid, Mistweaver Monk, Holy Priest, Affliction Warlock, plus one Non-class line for the Venomous Abyss encounter work, the Gnarldor Isle delve change, the Omnium Folio CC fix and a Group Finder move. All six lines classify null under classifyHighlight - checked, not assumed - so bug fixes cast no outlook vote. ONE LINE FROM THAT ROUND-UP IS DELIBERATELY NOT LOGGED AND IS AN OWNER ACTION: the Mage > Fire entry fixes a 2-piece SET BONUS, which would oblige Fire Mage's tierSet.asOf to advance and, since the 2026-08-23 two-page rule, oblige gearing/data/specs.json to be re-synced and rebuilt in the SAME change - which the nightly structurally cannot publish (publish stages data/, dist/ and skill logs, never gearing/), so a tracker-side bump would red the publish gate. Fire Mage is therefore absent from specsAffected rather than the line being reworded to dodge the gate; the citation and the exact local-run fix are in the entry's label and in the ptr-watch log. (2) The 08-28 'Class Tuning Incoming - September 1' post (topic 2342331) was edited to VERSION 4 at 2026-08-31T19:44:31Z, after last night read v3: the fifteen stored PvE lines are unchanged line for line and ONE LINE IS NEW - Shaman > Hero Talents > Farseer, correcting Natural Harmony to increase Nature's Guardian healing by its listed 10% rather than 20%. It sits under a bare Shaman heading with no spec block beneath it, so it is logged class-wide with the tree named in the line text (the 08-27 Evoker/Flameshaper and Rogue/Deathstalker precedent) rather than guessed onto Elemental or Restoration; class-wide lines reach the drawer and are excluded from the tally by construction. Lanes also polled and empty of anything else: Wowhead news RSS HTTP 200, 40 items 2026-08-27T18:53Z to 2026-09-01T09:30Z; the news INDEX (data.news.newsData); the blue tracker (data.blueTracker.default, 50 entries); and the dev-notes thread 2317811.json, 17 posts, last_posted_at 2026-07-31T23:42Z - correctly quiet for a closed cycle. Wowhead's 'Estimated DPS and Healing Increases for September 1st Class Tuning' (news=382697) is its own class writers' estimates of the already-logged pass, not a Blizzard post, and is deliberately NOT a feed entry. PTR zone lanes 54/52/56/57 stayed dormant per the between-cycles posture.

All 44 transcribable channels with a channelId polled via the YouTube RSS endpoint, 0 failures, 15 entries each = 660 videos, media:description parsed alongside each title. Seen-set recomputed from the four structured lanes (videos[]/skipped[]/seen[] plus every youtu.be id in a take or metaNote url) = 1222 ids; 254 unseen, all 254 inside the cycle (bound 2026-06-18, the OLDEST date in ptr-builds.json, taken as a date and not an index). This is a nightly, so the keyword filter governs QUEUEING: 174 of the 254 are keyword-relevant and the 171 not queued are budget dismissals left in NO lane so a local run reconsiders them. transcript-fetch/summary.json verdict 'ok', requested 3 / fetched 3, all three read in full. Distilled 1 take: Obli wPDn4G-8JNs (2026-08-30) -> Frost Death Knight, raid, sentiment buff - he works the September 1 values off his own logs (Howling Blast +15% also lifting Cryogenic Chamber because it stores Howling Blast damage), sizes them at about 6.5% single-target / 5% two-target, and lands on 'truly middle of the pack', not enough for Hall of Fame guilds but fine for ordinary raiders; his 2026-08-28 Frost RAID take is superseded (same creator, spec and lens) while his 08-28 Frost M+ and both Unholy takes stay live as different lenses. Two transcript-verified SKIPS, both recorded in skipped[] with reasons: Whispyr 1qclgMKPdz4 is an Assassination hero-tree/build and sim-correctness video (Fatebound vs Deathstalker execution cost, a Mass Casualty sim bug, a Font under-simming fix, a Wowhead guide pass) and Shadarek DJCr5_KFzcM is a Havoc BiS-list update driven by Font displacing a crit trinket - guide-shaped and gear-level claims respectively, so no take, and neither was minted as a filler neutral. Queued 3 keyword-relevant videos with no fetched transcript: izen nuUVv1WwfLM (general-creator metaNotes lane, a week-1/2 outcome-vs-PTR-prediction recap), Dalaran Gaming acRd5yk-3N0 and Critcake S2nGA4gww8I.
